source: Agence ORE — Consommation annuelle d'électricité et gaz par département
verification_method: electricity rows, year 2024, summed by 'Code Département'; sectors from 'CODE GRAND SECTEUR' (NAP -> unknown); n_delivery_points = sum of 'Nb sites'

automated_checks.result: department file exceeds the municipal sum by 0.12% nationally; lower in 4 departments (45, 59, 80, 95) by at most 0.03% — difference between extracts; department totals not reduced by secrecy ([RES] 10.10)

fields_note.n_rows_without_value: Number of department × sector rows that the source publishes without a consumption value. When above 0, consumption_mwh and the sector columns of this department are lower bounds.

known_gaps_draft: Annual metered energy in MWh, not peak power: not comparable with the modeled peak demand of the U.S. demand layer.

In 31 departments the source publishes 85 department × sector rows without a value; their consumption is not in the totals, so the totals of these departments are lower bounds (see n_rows_without_value).

Department totals are not reduced by the statistical confidentiality applied to municipalities: the department file exceeds the sum of the municipal file by 0.12% nationally; in 4 departments (45, 59, 80, 95) it is lower by at most 0.03%, which is treated as a difference between the two extracts.
